title: Replay: Europe and the US 'belong together', Rubio tells Munich Security Conference
summary: US Secretary of ​State Marco Rubio gave a ​robust message of unity with Europe on Saturday at the Munich Security ​Conference, ‌saying Washington's destiny ⁠was intertwined with Europe and that it had ‌no intention of abandoning the Transatlantic ⁠alliance. Watch his full address.
